description.narrative: Togo Threshold - INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATIONS project: The objectives of this project are to improve access to high-quality, reasonably-priced ICT services in Togo through: (1) increased competition among ICT service providers in the sector, (2) effective and independent regulation, (3) targeted investments and incentives, where necessary, to increase service in otherwise unprofitable areas, and (4) support for greater ICT utilization.
